scope: LibICloneableFactoryV4, ICloneableFactoryV4, ICloneableV2 and the test fixtures they rely on, in three groups: g1-derivations (both salt derivations, the domain tags, cloneCreationCode, predictCloneAddress), g2-clone-tail (checkImplementationCode, cloneAndInitialize, ICLONEABLE_V2_SUCCESS), g3-entry-points (the four clone and predict entry points, ICloneableV2 fixture conformance). src/interface/deprecated/ is excluded: it is frozen for pinned consumers.

PR branch 2026-10-20-beacon-proxy-open-salt (ICloneableFactoryV5 beacon proxies), in two groups: v5-beacon (LibICloneableFactoryV5.sol with its three proxy bytecode constants, opcode by opcode, and ICloneableFactoryV5.sol) and v4-tail (LibICloneableFactoryV4.sol functions the branch refactored: predictCreate2Address, predictCloneAddress, cloneAndInitialize, deployAndInitialize). The pre-existing suite is the branch's own suite at the scanned commit, written alongside the code. v5-beacon also ran a second pass of its 54 bytecode mutants with the exact-bytecode and expected-address tests excluded, to find behaviour only the byte pins caught.
